Measurement source, reference year, methodologyతో figureను పేర్కొనాలి

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Inland Waterwayకు సరైన నిర్వచనం ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the correct definition of an inland waterway?
questions.explanation_te: Inland water transport rivers, canals, backwaters, connected water bodiesపై జరుగుతుంది. Navigabilityకు depth, width, flow, locks, dredging, terminals, seasonality ముఖ్యమైనవి. ఇది Ocean sea routeతో వేరు.
questions.explanation_en: Inland water transport operates on rivers, canals, backwaters and connected water bodies. Navigability depends on depth, width, flow, locks, dredging, terminals and seasonality. It differs from an ocean sea route.
questions.source_paragraph: Inland waterway అంటే భూభాగం లోపల transportకు ఉపయోగించే navigable river, canal, backwater లేదా connected water body. Navigability depth, width, flow, locks, dredging, terminals, seasonalityపై ఆధారపడుతుంది.
questions.heading: పుట 441 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: An inland waterway is a navigable river, canal, backwater or connected water body used for transport within the land area.
options_te: భూభాగం లోపల రవాణాకు ఉపయోగించే navigable river, canal, backwater లేదా connected water body
options_en: Every international sea lane in the ocean
A drainage channel beside an airport runway
A navigable river, canal, backwater or connected water body used for transport within the land area
option_explanations_en: A road median is unrelated.
An ocean lane is not an inland waterway.
A drainage channel is not a transport waterway.
This is the correct definition.
options: భూభాగం లోపల రవాణాకు ఉపయోగించే navigable river, canal, backwater లేదా connected water body

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: NW-4 mapలో సరైన north-to-south sequenceకు అత్యంత దగ్గరైనది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which is the closest correct north-to-south sequence on the NW-4 map?
questions.explanation_te: NW-4 map northern Godavari reach నుంచి Rajahmundry/Kakinada delta, Eluru–Vijayawada canal links, Buckingham Canal మీదుగా Chennai–Marakkanam–Puducherry వైపు sequence చూపుతుంది. ఇది exact scale కాదు; connectivity sequence మాత్రమే.
questions.explanation_en: The NW-4 map shows a sequence from the northern Godavari reach through the Rajahmundry-Kakinada delta, Eluru-Vijayawada canal links and Buckingham Canal toward Chennai, Marakkanam and Puducherry. It shows connectivity, not exact scale.
questions.source_paragraph: National Waterway-4 (NW-4) northern Godavari reach నుంచి Rajahmundry–Kakinada delta, Eluru–Vijayawada canal links, Buckingham Canal మీదుగా Chennai–Marakkanam–Puducherry sector వరకు అనుసంధానం చూపుతుంది. Schematic map route connectivityను చూపుతుంది; exact scale లేదా year-round navigabilityను కాదు.
questions.heading: పుట 442 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: NW-4 connects the Godavari-Kakinada region through the Krishna-delta canal links and Buckingham Canal toward Chennai and Puducherry.
option_explanations_en: These are four separate river systems.
Delhi and Srinagar are not on NW-4.
Mumbai is not on this route.
This is the schematic route sequence.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Assertion (A): Buckingham Canalను NW-4 contextలో చదవాలి. Reason (R): ఇది Andhra–Tamil Nadu coast వెంట సాగి Kakinada–Puducherry integrated waterwayలో భాగమవుతుంది.
questions.question_en: Assertion (A): Buckingham Canal should be studied in the context of NW-4. Reason (R): It runs along the Andhra–Tamil Nadu coast and forms part of the integrated Kakinada–Puducherry waterway.
questions.explanation_te: Buckingham Canal Coromandel coast వెంట Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu ప్రాంతాలను అనుసంధానిస్తుంది. Krishna delta/Commamur canal linksతో కలిసి wider NW-4 corridorలో భాగం. Canal మొత్తం ప్రతి కాలంలో సమానంగా navigable అని మాత్రం ఈ association నిరూపించదు.
questions.explanation_en: Buckingham Canal follows the Coromandel coast across Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu. Together with Krishna-delta and Commamur canal links, it forms part of the wider NW-4 corridor. This association does not prove equal year-round navigability throughout the canal.
questions.source_paragraph: Buckingham Canal Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu Coromandel coastను అనుసరిస్తూ, Krishna delta, Commamur canal linksతో కలిసి Kakinada–Puducherry NW-4 corridorలో భాగం. Corridorలో భాగం కావడం ప్రతి segmentలో సమాన year-round navigability ఉందని నిరూపించదు.
questions.heading: పుట 441 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: Buckingham Canal follows the Andhra–Tamil Nadu coast and forms part of the integrated Kakinada–Puducherry National Waterway-4 corridor.
options_te: A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; కానీ R వివరణ కాదు
A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు సరైన వివరణ
options_en: A is false, but R is true
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
option_explanations_en: A is also true.
R does explain A.
The coastal linkage is true.
R directly explains the NW-4 association.
options: A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; కానీ R వివరణ కాదు
A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు సరైన వివరణ

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Port capacity, berth count, cargo rank వంటి figuresను ఎందుకు reference yearతో వాడాలి?
questions.question_en: Why should figures such as port capacity, berth count and cargo rank be stated with a reference year?
options_te: Expansion, dredging, ownership, traffic మార్పులతో figures మారుతాయి
Portsలో ఏ figure కూడా ఎప్పుడూ మారదు
Statutory categoryనే cargo rankను శాశ్వతంగా నిర్ణయిస్తుంది
options_en: Expansion, dredging, ownership and traffic changes alter the figures
No figure at a port ever changes
A reference year is needed only for maps
Statutory category permanently determines cargo rank
questions.explanation_te: New berths, channel deepening, mechanisation, concession changes, cargo demand వల్ల capacity, throughput, ranking మారతాయి. Major/Non-major statutory category governanceను చూపుతుంది; traffic rankను శాశ్వతంగా నిర్ణయించదు.
questions.explanation_en: New berths, channel deepening, mechanisation, concession changes and cargo demand can alter capacity, throughput and ranking. Major or non-major statutory status indicates governance; it does not permanently determine traffic rank.
option_explanations_en: This is why the data are dynamic.
Port figures change over time.
Tables and prose figures also need a year.
Governance category and cargo rank are different.
questions.source_paragraph: Port capacity, berth count, cargo throughput, rank కాలంతో మారే dynamic data. New berths, dredging, mechanisation, ownership or concession changes, cargo demand వీటిని మార్చుతాయి; అందువల్ల reference year తప్పనిసరి.
options: Expansion, dredging, ownership, traffic మార్పులతో figures మారుతాయి
Portsలో ఏ figure కూడా ఎప్పుడూ మారదు
Statutory categoryనే cargo rankను శాశ్వతంగా నిర్ణయిస్తుంది
questions.heading: పుట 440 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: Port capacities, berth inventories and cargo rankings are dynamic and require a reference year; statutory category does not determine traffic rank.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Port Hinterland అంటే ఏమిటి?
questions.question_en: What is a port hinterland?
options_te: ఆ Portకు సరుకు పంపే, అక్కడ దిగిన సరుకును స్వీకరించే అంతర్భాగం
options_en: The inland area that supplies cargo to and receives goods from the port
Only the water area inside the harbour
The sea outside the port breakwater
questions.explanation_te: Hinterland అనేది Portతో Road, Rail, Pipeline, Inland Waterwayల ద్వారా అనుసంధానమైన ఆర్థిక అంతర్భాగం. అక్కడి నుంచి Export cargo Portకు వస్తుంది; Imported goods Port నుంచి ఆ ప్రాంతానికి వెళ్తాయి. Hinterland boundaries స్థిర political boundaries కావు.
questions.explanation_en: A hinterland is the inland economic area connected to a port by roads, railways, pipelines or inland waterways. Export cargo moves from it to the port and imported goods move from the port into it. Hinterland boundaries are not fixed political boundaries.
option_explanations_en: This is the correct port-geography meaning.
Harbour water area is not the hinterland.
The offshore sea area is not the hinterland.
It is unrelated to an airport.
questions.source_paragraph: Port hinterland అంటే roads, railways, pipelines, inland waterways ద్వారా portతో అనుసంధానమైన inland economic area. Export cargo అక్కడి నుంచి portకు వస్తుంది; imports port నుంచి ఆ ప్రాంతానికి వెళ్తాయి. Hinterlandకు స్థిర political boundary ఉండదు.
options: ఆ Portకు సరుకు పంపే, అక్కడ దిగిన సరుకును స్వీకరించే అంతర్భాగం
questions.heading: పుట 431 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: A port hinterland is the inland economic area that supplies export cargo and receives imports through transport links.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: కింది Port–alias/renamed name జతలను పరిశీలించండి: 1. Kandla—Deendayal Port 2. Jawaharlal Nehru Port—Nhava Sheva 3. Kolkata Port—Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port 4. Tuticorin—V. O. Chidambaranar Port. సరైనవి ఏవి?
questions.question_en: Consider the following port alias/renamed-name pairs: 1. Kandla—Deendayal Port 2. Jawaharlal Nehru Port—Nhava Sheva 3. Kolkata Port—Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port 4. Tuticorin—V. O. Chidambaranar Port. Which are correct?
questions.explanation_te: నాలుగు జతలూ సరైనవి. Old name, current official name, common locality nameలను ఒకే columnలో కలపకుండా గుర్తుంచుకోవాలి: Kandla–Deendayal; JNPT–Nhava Sheva; Kolkata–Syama Prasad Mookerjee; Tuticorin–V. O. Chidambaranar.
questions.explanation_en: All four pairs are correct. Old names, current official names and common locality names should be distinguished: Kandla–Deendayal, JNPT–Nhava Sheva, Kolkata–Syama Prasad Mookerjee and Tuticorin–V. O. Chidambaranar.
option_explanations_en: Pairs 3 and 4 are also correct.
Pairs 1 and 4 are also correct.
Pair 2 is also correct.
All four pairs are correct.
questions.source_paragraph: Port namesలో official renamed form, common locality name వేరు చేయాలి: Kandla—Deendayal Port; Jawaharlal Nehru Port—Nhava Sheva; Kolkata Port—Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port; Tuticorin—V. O. Chidambaranar Port.
questions.heading: పుట 432 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: Several Indian ports have official renamed forms or common aliases: Deendayal, Nhava Sheva, Syama Prasad Mookerjee and V. O. Chidambaranar.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: సరైన Port–physical setting జత ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which port-physical setting pair is correct?
questions.explanation_te: Kolkata Hooghly Riverపై సముద్ర తీరానికి లోపల ఉన్న Riverine Port. Chennai Artificial Harbour. Mumbai, Visakhapatnam Natural Harbour settingsతో సంబంధం కలిగిన తీర Ports.
questions.explanation_en: Kolkata is a riverine port on the Hooghly, inland from the immediate coast. Chennai is an artificial harbour. Mumbai and Visakhapatnam are coastal ports associated with natural-harbour settings.
option_explanations_en: This pair is correct.
Chennai is an artificial harbour.
Mumbai has a natural-harbour setting.
Visakhapatnam is a coastal natural harbour.
questions.source_paragraph: Kolkata—Hooghlyపై riverine port; Chennai—artificial harbour; Mumbai, Visakhapatnam—natural-harbour settingsతో సంబంధం. Riverine, artificial, natural అనే terms port physical settingను సూచిస్తాయి.
questions.heading: పుట 432 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: Kolkata is riverine, Chennai artificial, and Mumbai and Visakhapatnam are associated with natural-harbour settings.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: కింది Port–specialisation జతల్లో సరికానిది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which port-specialisation pair is incorrect?
options_te: Paradip—Bulk cargo such as coal, ore, petroleum
Kolkata—India's first corporatised coal-only major port
options_en: Paradip—Bulk cargo such as coal, ore and petroleum
Kolkata—India's first corporatised coal-only major port
questions.explanation_te: First corporatised Major Port అనే గుర్తింపు Ennore/Kamarajarకు సంబంధించినది; ప్రారంభంలో Coal handling ప్రత్యేకత ఉంది. Kolkata riverine port, Haldia downstream supplement. JNPT containers, Mormugao iron ore, Paradip bulk cargo associations సరైనవి.
questions.explanation_en: The first corporatised Major Port distinction belongs to Ennore/Kamarajar, which initially specialised in coal handling. Kolkata is a riverine port supplemented downstream by Haldia. The JNPT-container, Mormugao-iron ore and Paradip-bulk cargo associations are correct.
option_explanations_te: ఇది తప్పు; corporatised coal-port description Kamarajarకు చెందుతుంది.
option_explanations_en: This association is correct.
This historical association is correct.
This bulk-cargo association is correct.
This is incorrect; the corporatised coal-port description belongs to Kamarajar.
questions.source_paragraph: JNPT container trafficకు; Mormugao iron ore associationకు; Paradip bulk cargoకు ప్రసిద్ధి. Ennore/Kamarajar భారతదేశపు first corporatised Major Port; ప్రారంభంలో coal-handling role ప్రధానంగా ఉంది.
options: Paradip—Bulk cargo such as coal, ore, petroleum
Kolkata—India's first corporatised coal-only major port
option_explanations: ఇది తప్పు; corporatised coal-port description Kamarajarకు చెందుతుంది.
questions.heading: పుట 432 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: JNPT is container-oriented, Mormugao has an iron-ore association, Paradip handles bulk cargo, and Kamarajar was India's first corporatised major port with an initial coal role.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Assertion (A): Haldia Dock Complexను Kolkata Port systemతో కలిసి చదవాలి. Reason (R): Hooghlyలో Kolkata upstream location, draft constraintsకు సహాయకంగా downstreamలో Haldiaను అభివృద్ధి చేశారు.
questions.question_en: Assertion (A): Haldia Dock Complex should be studied with the Kolkata port system. Reason (R): Haldia was developed downstream to supplement Kolkata in handling deeper-draft and bulk traffic affected by upstream river conditions.
options_te: A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు సరైన వివరణ
A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; కానీ R వివరణ కాదు
options_en: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.explanation_te: Kolkata Hooghlyపై Riverine Port. River channel, siltation, draft constraints నేపథ్యంలో downstream Haldia Dock Complex bulk/deeper-draft trafficను నిర్వహించేందుకు supplementగా అభివృద్ధి చెందింది. అందుకే రెండింటిని ఒక port systemగా చదవాలి.
questions.explanation_en: Kolkata is a riverine port on the Hooghly. In the context of river-channel, siltation and draft constraints, downstream Haldia developed as a supplement for bulk and deeper-draft traffic. The two should therefore be studied as one port system.
option_explanations_en: R explains the Haldia-Kolkata relationship.
R does explain A.
The downstream-supplement concept is correct.
A is also true.
questions.source_paragraph: Haldia Dock Complex upstream riverine Kolkata port systemను supplement చేస్తుంది. Hooghly channel, siltation, draft constraints నేపథ్యంలో deeper-draft, bulk trafficకు downstream Haldia అభివృద్ధి చేయబడింది.
options: A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; R, Aకు సరైన వివరణ
A, R రెండూ సరైనవి; కానీ R వివరణ కాదు
questions.heading: పుట 432 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: Haldia Dock Complex supplements the upstream riverine Kolkata port system for deeper-draft and bulk traffic.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: సరైన Port–locality/estuary జత ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which port-locality/estuary pair is correct?

questions.explanation_en: New Mangalore Port is at Panambur near the Gurupura-Netravati coastal setting. Mormugao is near the Zuari estuary, Kochi is associated with the Vembanad backwater setting, and Paradip lies on the Odisha coast.
option_explanations_en: This pair is correct.
Mormugao is near the Zuari estuary.
Kochi is associated with Vembanad.
Paradip lies on the Odisha coast.
questions.source_paragraph: New Mangalore Port—Panambur; Mormugao—Zuari estuary సమీపం; Kochi—Vembanad backwater setting; Paradip—Odisha coast.
questions.heading: పుట 431 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం

questions.explanation_en: NCPOR is at Vasco da Gama in Goa, NIOT is based in Chennai, and the book places NSDRC at Visakhapatnam. Institution, city and function should be studied together; establishment years require official-source confirmation.
option_explanations_en: Pairs 2 and 3 are also correct.
Pair 3 is also correct.
Pair 1 is also correct.

questions.question_te: Natural Harbour, Artificial Harbour మధ్య సరైన తేడా ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the correct distinction between a natural harbour and an artificial harbour?
options_te: Natural Harbourకు సహజ భౌగోళిక రక్షణ ప్రధానమైనది; Artificial Harbourలో breakwaters వంటి నిర్మాణాలతో రక్షణ సృష్టిస్తారు
Artificial Harbour తప్పనిసరిగా inland riverపై ఉంటుంది
రెండింటి మధ్య ఎలాంటి భౌతిక తేడా లేదు
options_en: A natural harbour relies mainly on natural geographic shelter; an artificial harbour creates shelter using structures such as breakwaters
Ships cannot enter a natural harbour
An artificial harbour must lie on an inland river
There is no physical distinction between them
questions.explanation_te: Natural Harbour headland, bay, island వంటి సహజ features వల్ల waves నుంచి రక్షణ పొందుతుంది. Artificial Harbourలో breakwaters, dredged channels, basins వంటి engineering worksతో safe berthing conditions సృష్టిస్తారు. Mumbai/Visakhapatnam natural settings; Chennai artificial harbour ఉదాహరణలు.
questions.explanation_en: A natural harbour gains shelter from natural features such as bays, headlands or islands. An artificial harbour creates safe berthing conditions through engineering works such as breakwaters, dredged channels and basins. Mumbai and Visakhapatnam illustrate natural settings, while Chennai is artificial.
option_explanations_en: This is the physical-engineering distinction.
Natural harbours are used for navigation.
An artificial harbour may be coastal.
The source of shelter differs.
questions.source_paragraph: Natural harbourలో bay, headland, island వంటి సహజ భౌగోళిక ఆకృతులు ప్రధాన shelter ఇస్తాయి. Artificial harbourలో breakwaters, sea walls వంటి నిర్మాణాలతో waves నుంచి shelter సృష్టిస్తారు.
options: Natural Harbourకు సహజ భౌగోళిక రక్షణ ప్రధానమైనది; Artificial Harbourలో breakwaters వంటి నిర్మాణాలతో రక్షణ సృష్టిస్తారు
Artificial Harbour తప్పనిసరిగా inland riverపై ఉంటుంది
రెండింటి మధ్య ఎలాంటి భౌతిక తేడా లేదు
questions.heading: పుట 432 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: Natural harbours derive shelter mainly from geographic form, whereas artificial harbours create shelter through engineered works.

options_te: Air Corporations Act framework (1953) → Air India–Indian Airlines merger approval (2007) → Air India transfer to Tata group (2022)
Tata transfer (2022) → Air Corporations Act (1953) → merger (2007)
Merger (2007) → Air Corporations Act (1953) → Tata transfer (2022)

options_en: Air Corporations Act framework (1953) → Air India–Indian Airlines merger approval (2007) → Air India transfer to Tata group (2022)
Tata transfer (2022) → Air Corporations Act (1953) → merger (2007)

questions.explanation_te: 1953 Actతో ప్రభుత్వ airline framework ఏర్పడింది. 2007లో Air India–Indian Airlines merger ఆమోదించబడింది. 2022లో Air India Tata groupకు బదిలీ అయింది. Airline name, merger, ownership change వేర్వేరు milestones.
questions.explanation_en: The 1953 Act created the state airline framework. The Air India–Indian Airlines merger was approved in 2007, and Air India transferred to the Tata group in 2022. Airline naming, merger and ownership change are distinct milestones.

It places 2022 before 1953.
It places 2007 before 1953.
It places the 2007 merger after 2022.

questions.explanation_te: పుస్తక conventionలో National Highwayకు Yellow–White, State Highwayకు Green–White, City Roadకు Black–White bands ఇచ్చారు. Signage standards change/standardise కావచ్చు కాబట్టి ప్రశ్నలో source convention స్పష్టంగా ఉండాలి.
questions.explanation_en: The book's convention assigns yellow-white to National Highways, green-white to State Highways and black-white to city roads. Because signage standards may be revised or standardised, the source convention should be explicit in the question.
option_explanations_en: This pair matches the book's convention.
State Highway is green-white.
City road is black-white.
This colour pair is not given.
questions.source_paragraph: పుస్తకంలో ఇచ్చిన milestone colour convention ప్రకారం National Highway—Yellow and White. Current sign or marker practiceను వేరే official standardతో ధృవీకరించాలి.
questions.heading: పుట 420 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: The book associates yellow-white with National Highways, green-white with State Highways and black-white with city roads.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Golden Quadrilateral mapను సరిగ్గా చదివిన వాక్యం ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which statement correctly interprets a map of the Golden Quadrilateral?
options_te: Delhi–Kolkata–Chennai–Mumbai metropolitan nodesను నాలుగు ప్రధాన armsతో కలిపే highway network
Indiaలోని ప్రతి districtను ఒకే straight roadతో కలిపే route
North–South, East–West Corridorsతో పూర్తిగా ఒకే network
Port cargo trafficను చూపే proportional-circle map
options_en: A highway network linking the Delhi–Kolkata–Chennai–Mumbai metropolitan nodes through four principal arms
A single straight road linking every district in India
A network completely identical to the North–South and East–West Corridors
A proportional-circle map of port cargo traffic
questions.explanation_te: Golden Quadrilateral Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Mumbaiను Delhi–Kolkata, Kolkata–Chennai, Chennai–Mumbai, Mumbai–Delhi armsతో కలుపుతుంది. ఇది North–South/East–West Corridorsతో intersect అయినా అదే network కాదు. Schematic map exact straight-line distance చూపదు.
questions.explanation_en: The Golden Quadrilateral links Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai and Mumbai through the Delhi–Kolkata, Kolkata–Chennai, Chennai–Mumbai and Mumbai–Delhi arms. It intersects the North–South and East–West Corridors but is not identical to them. A schematic map does not show exact straight-line distance.
option_explanations_en: This is the network structure.
It is not one straight road.
The networks are distinct though they intersect.
It is a highway-connectivity map.
questions.source_paragraph: Golden Quadrilateral map Delhi–Kolkata–Chennai–Mumbai metropolitan nodesను four principal highway armsతో కలిపే networkను చూపుతుంది; ఇది simple geometric square లేదా single road కాదు.
options: Delhi–Kolkata–Chennai–Mumbai metropolitan nodesను నాలుగు ప్రధాన armsతో కలిపే highway network
Indiaలోని ప్రతి districtను ఒకే straight roadతో కలిపే route
North–South, East–West Corridorsతో పూర్తిగా ఒకే network
Port cargo trafficను చూపే proportional-circle map
questions.heading: పుట 435 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: The Golden Quadrilateral links Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai and Mumbai through four arms and is distinct from the North-South and East-West Corridors.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: 2023–24 Major-port proportional-circle mapలో Mundra, Vadhvan కనిపిస్తే సరైన interpretation ఏది?
questions.question_en: If Mundra and Vadhvan appear on a 2023–24 major-port proportional-circle map, what is the correct interpretation?
options_te: Mapలో spatial contextగా కనిపించడం వాటిని అదే statutory/operational categoryగా నిరూపించదు
Mapలో కనిపించిన ప్రతి place Union Major Port
Vadhvan అప్పటికే highest-traffic operational port అని నిర్ధారిస్తుంది
Mundra cargo circle Harbour areaను చూపుతుంది
options_en: Their appearance for spatial context does not prove identical statutory or operational status
Every place shown is necessarily a Union Major Port
It proves Vadhvan was already the highest-traffic operational port
Mundra's cargo circle shows harbour area
questions.explanation_te: Mundra private/non-major port; Vadhvan project. Map ఒకే frameలో context కోసం చూపించిన symbolsను statutory categoryగా కలపకూడదు. Proportional circle cargo trafficను చూపుతుంది, physical harbour sizeను కాదు; ranking 2023–24కే పరిమితం.
questions.explanation_en: Mundra is a private or non-major port, while Vadhvan is a project. Symbols shown together for spatial context must not be conflated with statutory category. A proportional circle represents cargo traffic, not physical harbour size, and the ranking is limited to 2023–24.
option_explanations_en: This is the correct map discipline.
Symbols do not equal statutory status.
Project status does not prove operational traffic.
The circle represents the cargo variable.
questions.source_paragraph: Proportional-circle port mapలో Mundra, Vadhvan వంటి locations spatial context కోసం కనిపించడం వాటికి map reference yearలో identical statutory, construction లేదా operational status ఉందని నిరూపించదు. Symbol size, legend, data year చూడాలి.
options: Mapలో spatial contextగా కనిపించడం వాటిని అదే statutory/operational categoryగా నిరూపించదు
Mapలో కనిపించిన ప్రతి place Union Major Port
Vadhvan అప్పటికే highest-traffic operational port అని నిర్ధారిస్తుంది
Mundra cargo circle Harbour areaను చూపుతుంది
questions.heading: పుట 435 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: A port map may show major ports, private ports and projects for context; symbol size and statutory category must be interpreted separately.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Short- and medium-distance connectivityలో Road transport ప్రత్యేక ప్రయోజనం ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the distinctive advantage of road transport for short- and medium-distance connectivity?
options_te: Ocean bulk cargoలో అత్యల్ప unit cost ఎప్పుడూ
options_en: Always the lowest unit cost for ocean bulk cargo
questions.explanation_te: Roads settlements, farms, markets, stations, ports మధ్య direct/last-mile access ఇస్తాయి. Rail, Water, Air modesతో Intermodal connectionను పూర్తి చేస్తాయి. అయితే long-distance bulk cargoలో road ఎప్పుడూ cheapest mode కాదు.
questions.explanation_en: Roads provide direct and last-mile access between settlements, farms, markets, stations and ports and complete intermodal connections with rail, water and air. They are not always the cheapest mode for long-distance bulk cargo.
option_explanations_te: Ocean bulk cargoకు Water transport advantage ఉండవచ్చు.
option_explanations_en: This is the road-transport advantage.
Water transport may be advantageous for ocean bulk cargo.
Gauge conversion concerns railways.
Dredging concerns ports and waterways.
questions.source_paragraph: Road transport short, medium distancesలో door-to-door or last-mile access, flexible routing అందిస్తుంది. Rail, water transportతో పోలిస్తే dispersed settlementsను చేరడంలో ఇది ముఖ్య advantage.
options: Ocean bulk cargoలో అత్యల్ప unit cost ఎప్పుడూ
option_explanations: Ocean bulk cargoకు Water transport advantage ఉండవచ్చు.
questions.heading: పుట 436 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: Road transport provides flexible short- and medium-distance connectivity and last-mile access within a multimodal system.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: కింది Road class–function జతల్లో సరికానిది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which road class-function pair is incorrect?
options_te: State Highway—District headquarters, important towns, state network
District Road—District headquarters to mandal/market centres
Village Road—Local access to villages and mandal/market centres
Panchayat Road—Union government exclusively maintains every such road
options_en: State Highway—District headquarters, important towns and the state network
District Road—District headquarters to mandal and market centres
Village Road—Local access to villages and mandal or market centres
Panchayat Road—Every such road is maintained exclusively by the Union government
questions.explanation_te: Panchayat roads local self-government bodies నిర్వహణలో ఉంటాయి; Union-exclusive category కాదు. State, District, Village road functions optionsలో సరిగ్గా ఉన్నాయి. Administrative responsibility, surface type వేర్వేరు.
questions.explanation_en: Panchayat roads are maintained under local self-government bodies and are not an exclusively Union-maintained category. The stated State, District and Village road functions are correct. Administrative responsibility and surface type are separate matters.
option_explanations_en: This function is correct.
This feeder function is correct.
This local-access function is correct.
This is incorrect; it belongs to panchayat or local-body responsibility.
questions.source_paragraph: Panchayat Roads స్థానిక rural connectivityకు సేవ చేస్తాయి; ప్రతి Panchayat Roadను Union Government మాత్రమే maintain చేస్తుందని చెప్పడం తప్పు. Maintenance responsibility road ownership, local-government arrangementపై ఆధారపడుతుంది.
options: State Highway—District headquarters, important towns, state network
District Road—District headquarters to mandal/market centres
Village Road—Local access to villages and mandal/market centres
Panchayat Road—Union government exclusively maintains every such road
questions.heading: పుట 436 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: State, district, village and panchayat roads serve different network functions and administrative responsibilities.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: National Highways governance historyకు సరైన జత ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which pair correctly represents National Highways governance history?
questions.explanation_te: National Highways Act 1956కు చెందింది. NHAIను 1988 Act కింద ఏర్పాటు చేసి 1995లో operational organisationగా పనిచేయడం ప్రారంభించింది. Highway law, authority creation, operationalisation వేర్వేరు milestones.
questions.explanation_en: The National Highways Act dates to 1956. NHAI was created under the 1988 Act and became operational as an organisation in 1995. Highway legislation, authority creation and operationalisation are separate milestones.
option_explanations_en: This pair is correct.
It reverses the years.
2000 is the PMGSY launch year.
2017 is the Railway Budget merger year.
questions.source_paragraph: National Highways Act—1956; National Highways Authority of India Act (NHAI Act)—1988. మొదటిది National Highways declaration, land and related legal frameworkకు; రెండవది NHAI establishmentకు సంబంధించినది.
questions.heading: పుట 436 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: The National Highways Act dates to 1956, while NHAI was constituted under the 1988 Act and became operational in 1995.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: సరైన Andhra Pradesh transport-history/project జత ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which Andhra Pradesh transport-history/project pair is correct?
options_te: Puttur–Renigunta—ప్రస్తుత AP ప్రాంతంలో మొదటి railway lineగా పుస్తకం 1862తో అనుసంధానించింది
options_en: Puttur–Renigunta—The book associates it with the first railway line in present-day AP territory in 1862
questions.explanation_te: పుస్తకం Puttur–Renigunta sectionను 1862లో ప్రస్తుత AP భూభాగంలోని తొలి railway lineగా పేర్కొంది. Chittoor–Thatchur Surat–Chennai economic corridorలో expressway component. SH-31 printed route Renigunta–Kadapa–Muddanur direction; current numbering verify చేయాలి.
questions.explanation_en: The book identifies the Puttur–Renigunta section opened in 1862 as the first railway line in the territory of present-day Andhra Pradesh. Chittoor–Thatchur is an expressway component of the Surat–Chennai economic corridor. The printed SH-31 follows the Renigunta–Kadapa–Muddanur direction and requires current-number verification.
option_explanations_en: This historical pair is correct.
SH-31 is a road route, not a waterway.
Chittoor–Thatchur is an expressway component.
It is an economic road corridor.
questions.source_paragraph: పుస్తకం ప్రకారం present-day Andhra Pradesh territoryలో earliest railway associationగా 1862 Puttur–Renigunta sectionను పేర్కొంటుంది. Historical boundary, route terminologyతో ఈ printed claimను చదవాలి.
options: Puttur–Renigunta—ప్రస్తుత AP ప్రాంతంలో మొదటి railway lineగా పుస్తకం 1862తో అనుసంధానించింది
questions.heading: పుట 436 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: The printed chapter associates the 1862 Puttur-Renigunta section with AP railway history and distinguishes it from current road-corridor projects.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: సరైన Maritime institution–location/function జతను గుర్తించండి.
questions.question_en: Identify the correctly matched maritime institution-location/function pair.
options_te: T. S. Rajendra—Mumbai maritime training establishment
Lal Bahadur Shastri maritime college—Guwahati rail training
Marine Engineering Training directorate—కేవలం Delhi airport management
options_en: T. S. Rajendra—Maritime training establishment at Mumbai
Lal Bahadur Shastri maritime college—Rail training at Guwahati
Marine Engineering Training directorate—Only Delhi airport management
questions.explanation_te: T. S. Rajendra Mumbai maritime training establishment. Lal Bahadur Shastri College of Advanced Maritime Studies and Research Mumbaiలో ఉంది. Marine Engineering Training centres Mumbai, Kolkataలో cadetsకు శిక్షణ ఇచ్చాయి. National Shipping Board shipping-policy institution.
questions.explanation_en: T. S. Rajendra was a maritime training establishment at Mumbai. Lal Bahadur Shastri College of Advanced Maritime Studies and Research is also in Mumbai. Marine Engineering Training centres at Mumbai and Kolkata trained cadets. The National Shipping Board belongs to shipping policy.
option_explanations_te: Centres Mumbai, Kolkataలో marine training ఇచ్చాయి.
option_explanations_en: This pair is correct.
The college is in Mumbai.
The Mumbai and Kolkata centres provided marine training.
The Board concerns shipping.
questions.source_paragraph: T. S. Rajendraను Mumbaiలోని maritime training establishmentగా పుస్తకం జత చేసింది. Historical institution names, present institutional structure మారవచ్చు కాబట్టి reference periodను గుర్తించాలి.
options: T. S. Rajendra—Mumbai maritime training establishment
Lal Bahadur Shastri maritime college—Guwahati rail training
Marine Engineering Training directorate—కేవలం Delhi airport management
option_explanations: Centres Mumbai, Kolkataలో marine training ఇచ్చాయి.
questions.heading: పుట 430 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: The printed chapter distinguishes shipping policy, maritime studies and marine-engineering training institutions.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Suez Canalకు సంబంధించిన సరైన statement ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which statement about the Suez Canal is correct?
options_te: 1859–1869 నిర్మాణం; November 1869 opening; March 2021 Ever Given blockage
options_en: Constructed during 1859–1869; opened in November 1869; Ever Given blockage in March 2021
Construction began in 1869 and it opened in 1859
Ever Given blocked the canal in 1921
questions.explanation_te: Suez Canal నిర్మాణం 1859–1869 మధ్య జరిగి November 1869లో తెరుచుకుంది. March 2021లో Ever Given blockage global supply chainsలో chokepoint riskను చూపింది. Canal ద్వారా Persian Gulf petroleum westward, manufactured goods eastward వంటి trade flows సాగుతాయి.
questions.explanation_en: The Suez Canal was constructed during 1859–1869 and opened in November 1869. The March 2021 Ever Given blockage demonstrated chokepoint risk in global supply chains. The route carries flows such as Persian Gulf petroleum westward and manufactured goods eastward.
option_explanations_en: This chronology is correct.
The dates are wrong.
It reverses the chronology.
The blockage occurred in March 2021.
questions.source_paragraph: Suez Canal construction 1859–1869 మధ్య జరిగింది; November 1869లో opened. Container ship Ever Given March 2021లో canalను block చేసింది.
options: 1859–1869 నిర్మాణం; November 1869 opening; March 2021 Ever Given blockage
questions.heading: పుట 430 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: The Suez Canal was built in 1859-1869, opened in November 1869 and was blocked by Ever Given in March 2021.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: కింది Road Plan–period జతల్లో సరైనది ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which Road Plan-period pair is correct?
questions.explanation_te: Nagpur Road Planను 1943–1963 మొదటి 20-year planగా చదువుతారు. Bombay Plan రెండవ 20-year planగా 1961–1981తో సంబంధం. Lucknow Plan తరువాతి దశలో rural connectivity, primary–secondary–tertiary systemsపై దృష్టి పెట్టింది.
questions.explanation_en: The Nagpur Road Plan is studied as the first 20-year plan for 1943–1963. The Bombay Plan is the second 20-year plan, associated with 1961–1981. The later Lucknow Plan emphasised rural connectivity and primary-secondary-tertiary systems.
option_explanations_en: This period is correct.
The Bombay Plan is associated with 1961–1981.
This period belongs to the Bombay Plan.
This is not the Nagpur Plan period.
questions.source_paragraph: Nagpur Road Plan period 1943–1963. ఇది మొదటి 20-year road-development planగా road classification, network planningకు పునాది వేసింది.
questions.heading: పుట 417 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: Nagpur was the first 20-year Road Plan for 1943-1963; Bombay was the second for 1961-1981, followed by Lucknow's network and rural-connectivity emphasis.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: National Highways ప్రధాన functional role ఏది?
questions.question_en: What is the principal functional role of National Highways?
options_te: State capitals, major ports, trade cities, rail junctions, strategic areasను అనుసంధానించడం
options_en: Connect state capitals, major ports, trade cities, rail junctions and strategic areas
Maintain only streets within one village
questions.explanation_te: National Highways long-distance inter-state connectivity backbone. NHAI, MoRTH/CPWD, BRO వంటి agencies వేర్వేరు contextsలో developmentలో పాత్ర పోషిస్తాయి. Village streets, harbour dredging, aviation safety వేర్వేరు administrative functions.
questions.explanation_en: National Highways form the backbone of long-distance interstate connectivity. Agencies such as NHAI, MoRTH or CPWD and BRO have roles in different development contexts. Village streets, harbour dredging and aviation safety are separate functions.
option_explanations_en: This is the NH functional role.
This is a local-road function.
This is a maritime function.
This is an aviation-regulatory function.
questions.source_paragraph: National Highways state capitals, Major Ports, major trade and industrial cities, important railway junctions, strategic areasను inter-state networkతో కలుపుతాయి.
options: State capitals, major ports, trade cities, rail junctions, strategic areasను అనుసంధానించడం
questions.heading: పుట 417 · రవాణా మరియు అనుసంధానం
questions.excerpt: National Highways connect major political, commercial, port, railway and strategic nodes through an interstate network.

questions.label: Original APPSC-style practice; not an official previous-year question
questions.question_te: Secondary, spur National Highway numberingను సరిగ్గా వివరించే వాక్యం ఏది?
questions.question_en: Which statement correctly explains secondary and spur National Highway numbering?
options_te: Secondary routesకు parent numberకు అదనపు digit; spur routesకు A, B, C వంటి suffix letters ఉండవచ్చు
ప్రతి spurకు కొత్త single-digit number మాత్రమే
options_en: Secondary routes may add a digit to the parent number, while spurs may use suffix letters such as A, B or C
Every spur receives only a new single-digit number
questions.explanation_te: New NH numberingలో secondary routes parent highwayతో సంబంధం చూపే అదనపు digitను పొందవచ్చు; spur/branch designationsలో A, B, C వంటి letters కనిపించవచ్చు. Numberను route description, Gazette scheduleతో కలిసి చదవాలి.
questions.explanation_en: Under the newer NH system, secondary routes may receive an added digit related to the parent highway, and spur or branch designations may carry letters such as A, B or C. The number must be read with the route description and gazette schedule.
option_explanations_en: This is the numbering logic.
Spurs may use suffix letters.

The Godavari is a river, not a gauge.

questions.excerpt: PPP, EPC, BOT and BOOT are distinct project-delivery and concession concepts.

Nizampatnam and Vodarevu are separate coastal port proposals or locations.
